items.headline: Pope Leo XIV Peru pahunche, ghar wapsi
items.detail: Pope Leo XIV budhwar ko Peru pahunche — apni dakshin America yatra ka aakhri charan; ve wahan 20 saal se zyada missionary aur Chiclayo ke bishop rahe, aur chhah din me Lima, Chiclayo, Cusco aur Amazon ka daura karenge.

items.headline: Brooklyn me imarat giri: 1 ki maut
items.detail: New York ke Brooklyn ke Flatbush me budhwar shaam ek 3-manzila imarat paas ki khudai wali jagah me gir gayi; kam se kam 1 ki maut aur 12 ghayal hue, jinme 6 gambhir hain; malbe me fase logon ki talash jaari hai, lagbhag 250 damkalkarmi lage hain.
items.exam_angle: Shahri suraksha aur imarat niyam — nagar prashasan aur apda prabandhan ke liye mahatvapurna.

items.headline: COP31: Iran ne yuddh nuksan ka muawza manga
items.detail: COP31 me Iran ke Rashtrapati Pezeshkian ne kaha ki America aur Israel ke hamlo se hue paryavaran nuksan ka muawza milna chahiye, aur yuddh ke samay ki zimmedari ko jalvayu pratibaddhataon se joda jana chahiye.
items.exam_angle: Jalvayu sammelan aur yuddh ka paryavaran prabhav — COP31 ke liye mahatvapurna.

items.headline: Brazil ne Facebook par $1.3M jurmana lagaya
items.detail: Brazil ki chunav adalat ne Meta ke Facebook par 7.5 million reais (lagbhag $1.3 million) ka jurmana lagaya, kyunki usne pichle mahine ke rashtrapati chunav ke dauran adalat ke aadeshon ka poori tarah palan nahi kiya; adalat ne kaha chunav ko janbujhkar prabhavit karne ka saboot abhi nahi mila.
items.exam_angle: Social media aur chunav aachar sanhita — chunav me platform ki bhoomika.

items.headline: Storm Charles: Portugal me sab band
items.detail: Atlantic toofan Charles ke aane par Portugal me lagbhag 8,000 school band rahe aur 300 se zyada udanein radd hui; 120 km/h se zyada ki hawa chali, lekin bada nuksan nahi hua.
items.exam_angle: Charam mausam aur jalvayu parivartan — COP31 ke dauraan ka mahatvapurna mudda.

items.headline: Riyadh ki taraf 3 Houthi missile girayi gayi
items.detail: Saudi netritva wale gathbandhan ne budhwar ko Riyadh ki ore aayi teen Houthi cruise missile ko hawa me hi nasht kar diya; koi nuksan ya hatahat ki khabar nahi hai.
items.exam_angle: Yemen-Saudi sangharsh aur tel suraksha — antarrashtriya sambandh ke liye mahatvapurna.

items.headline: Abu Dhabi vaarta khatm, safalta nahi
items.detail: America ki madhyasthata wali Abu Dhabi vaarta do din baad khatm hui; badi kaidi adla-badli par sahmati bani, lekin yuddh-viram ya seema par koi safalta nahi mili; Kushner aur Witkoff ab Putin se milne Moscow jayenge.
items.exam_angle: Russia-Ukraine yuddh aur shanti vaarta — antarrashtriya sambandh ke liye mahatvapurna.

items.headline: Iran: Europe ke US base bhi nishane par
items.detail: Iran ke suraksha pramukh Mohsen Rezaei ne kaha, America ne phir hamla kiya to Europe me sthit US sainya base bhi nishana banenge; unhone samriddh uranium desh se bahar na bhejne ki baat bhi dohrai.
items.exam_angle: West Asia me tanav aur America-Iran takraav — antarrashtriya sambandh ke liye mahatvapurna.

items.headline: Italy: farzi bomb dhamki se 300 school khali
items.detail: Italy ke lagbhag 6,300 schoolon ko email par farzi bomb ki dhamki mili, jiske baad kam se kam 300 school khali karaye gaye; Scotland aur Northern Ireland me bhi aisi dhamki mili, lekin wahan koi khatra nahi mana gaya aur koi visfotak nahi mila.
items.exam_angle: Europe me hybrid warfare aur cyber-suraksha — antarrashtriya suraksha ke liye mahatvapurna.

items.headline: Kohat me hamla: 10 police shaheed
items.detail: Khyber Pakhtunkhwa ke Kohat me avaidh sone ki khanan ke khilaf operation se laut rahi police team par hamla hua; DSP Haidar Zaman samet 10 police karmchari shaheed hue, 18 hamlaawar bhi maare gaye.
items.exam_angle: Pakistan me aatankwad aur suraksha sthiti — padosi desh ke halaat, antarrashtriya sambandh ke liye mahatvapurna.

items.headline: Abu Dhabi: badi kaidi adla-badli par sahmati
items.detail: America ki madhyasthata wali Abu Dhabi vaarta me Russia aur Ukraine badi kaidi adla-badli par sahmat hue; Kushner ne ise yuddh ki sabse badi kaidi rihai bataya, aankde kal tay honge, yuddhviram par abhi koi sahmati nahi.
items.exam_angle: Russia-Ukraine shaanti vaarta aur kaidi adla-badli — antarrashtriya sambandh ke liye mahatvapurna.

items.headline: Gibran ke khilaf mahabhiyog yachika, 120 sansad
items.detail: Indonesia ki sansad me aath dalon ke 120 sansadon ne up-rashtrapati Gibran Rakabuming Raka ke khilaf mahabhiyog ki yachika di; unhone Mangalvaar ko rashtrapati Prabowo se istifa ka irada bhi jataya tha.
items.exam_angle: Indonesia me up-rashtrapati par mahabhiyog prakriya — dakshin-poorv Asia ki rajneeti ke liye mahatvapurna.

items.headline: Spain me 14 saal baad aam hadtaal
items.detail: Awaas sankat par laakhon mazdoor hadtaal par gaye; 29 November ke chunaav se pehle parivahan aur factory ka kaam thap hua.
items.exam_angle: Awaas sankat aur shramik andolan — Spain ke 29 November chunaav se pehle ka bada mudda; UPSC ke liye antarrashtriya arthvyavastha aur shram muddon se juda.

items.headline: Russia ki refining kshamata 30% ghata
items.detail: Ukraine ke drone hamlo se October ke ant se Russia ki tel refining kshamata lagbhag 30% kam hui; Kirishi refinery par hamle me aag lagi aur ek mahila ki maut hui.
items.exam_angle: Russia-Ukraine yuddh, urja suraksha aur global tel bazaar — antarrashtriya sambandh ke liye mahatvapurna.

items.headline: Hormuz me phir tanker me aag
items.detail: Iran ki sena ne kaha ki aaj subah ek tanker ne Hormuz ke poorv me pratibandhit kshetra me mine se takrakar aag pakad li; Mangalvaar ko bhi teen tanker jal uthe the.
items.exam_angle: Hormuz se tel vyapaar aur antarrashtriya suraksha — arthvyavastha ke liye mahatvapurna.

items.headline: Iran ne Argentina ki sena 'aatankwadi' kahi
items.detail: Iran ne Argentina ki nausena aur vayusena ko aatankwadi sangathan ghoshit kiya; Buenos Aires ne April me IRGC ko aatankwadi ghoshit kiya tha, Iran ne ise usi ka badla bataya.
items.exam_angle: Iran-Argentina tanaav aur parasparik pratibandh — antarrashtriya sambandh ke liye mahatvapurna.

items.headline: COP31: netaon ka shikhar sammelan aaj se
items.detail: Antalya me COP31 ke netaon ke shikhar sammelan me duniya bhar ke neta jalvayu par bhaashan denge; Turkey bijli ki hissedari 2035 tak 35% karne ka prastav rakhega, America doosre saal bhi shamil nahi.
items.exam_angle: COP31, 1.5°C lakshya aur jalvayu vitt — paryavaran aur antarrashtriya sammelan ke liye mahatvapurna.

items.headline: Britain: US sena adhikari jasusi aarop me giraftar
items.detail: Britain me NATO unit me tainat 41 saal ke ek senior US sena adhikari ko Russia ke liye jasusi ke sandeh me giraftar kiya gaya; police ne saaf kiya ki iska RAF Fairford wale mamle se koi lena-dena nahi hai.
items.exam_angle: NATO, jasusi aur antarrashtriya suraksha — antarrashtriya sambandh ke liye mahatvapurna.

items.headline: Maldives: Israeli passport par sthayi rok ka bill
items.detail: Maldives ke Rashtrapati Muizzu ne sansad me bill pesh kiya jo Israeli passport walon ke pravesh par bina shart sthayi rok lagayega; pehle ki rok Gaza yuddh se judi thi, kanoon abhi bana nahi hai.
items.exam_angle: Maldives aur West Asia ki rajneeti — padosi deshon ke sambandh ke liye mahatvapurna.

items.headline: Naya COVID variant PJ.2.1 kai deshon me
items.detail: SARS-CoV-2 ka naya variant PJ.2.1 America, Spain, France, Singapore aur Australia samet kai deshon me mila; WHO is par nazar rakhe hue hai, lekin gambhir bimari ke zyada khatre ka koi saboot abhi nahi hai.
items.exam_angle: Swasthya aur WHO ki nigrani — vigyan aur swasthya ke liye mahatvapurna.

items.headline: Lithuania me drone: NATO jets hue scramble
items.detail: Belarus ki taraf se aaye sandeh wale drone par Lithuania me raat bhar do baar hawai alert jaari hua; NATO ke ladaku vimaan do baar ude, ek drone hawai seema me ghusa aur Latvia ki taraf nikal gaya, Vilnius aur Kaunas airport kuch der ke liye band rahe.
items.exam_angle: NATO ki Baltic Air Policing aur drone ghuspaith par pratikriya — antarrashtriya suraksha ke liye mahatvapurna.

items.headline: Kennedy parivar Trump ke arch ke khilaf
items.detail: Kennedy parivar ke nau sadasyon ne adalat se Trump ki 250-foot ki smarak arch par rok lagane ki mang ki; unka kehna hai arch se Arlington me unke parijanon ki kabron par chhaya padegi.

items.headline: North Hollywood haadsa: gaadi ne 3 ko kuchla
items.detail: Los Angeles ke North Hollywood me ek safed SUV metro station ke paas paidal chal rahe logon aur thele walon par chadh gayi; 3 log mare aur 3 gambhir roop se ghayal hue, haadse ki wajah abhi jaanch me hai.

items.headline: House ne Hegseth ke khilaf mahabhiyog roka
items.detail: America ki House ne 211-204 se raksha mantri Pete Hegseth ke khilaf mahabhiyog prastav ko committee ko bhej diya; Iran yuddh par aaropon par turant vote ab nahi hoga, Democrats January me phir koshish kar sakte hain.
items.exam_angle: America me mahabhiyog prakriya aur Iran yuddh par Congress ki bhoomika — antarrashtriya sambandh ke liye mahatvapurna.
